name: Study Tutor
tagline: An AI tutor that teaches from your own lecture slides, PDFs and notes.
description:
Study Tutor is an AI tutor for university courses. Add your lecture PDFs, slides or notes and the AI reads them, builds a topic map, and teaches you one small idea at a time, citing the page or slide it used.

**How it works:** open the app and add a course, or try the demo Cell Biology course. For each topic the AI writes a short lesson from your material and sets a small task. You answer in your own words, and the AI grades the answer, explains what was missing and records the misunderstanding. Topics then come back on a spaced-repetition schedule (1 → 3 → 7 → 16 → 35 days), and AI-written quizzes aim at your weak spots.

**What it reads:** PDF, PPTX, DOCX, TXT and MD files, or pasted text. Files are read in the app window, and your courses and progress are kept in your own Anna storage. Excerpts are sent to Anna's AI to write lessons and grade answers. Scanned pages without a text layer can't be read, so paste their text instead.

**In chat:** mention #Study Tutor to open the window. People who keep a local study folder can also run the chat skills against it with a local Anna Agent; that folder is separate from the window's courses.

Open source (MIT): https://github.com/dymchenkko/claude-study-agent
